:description: Recommission the given broker if it is still decommissioning. Recommissioning can stop an active decommission.
Recommission the given broker if it is still decommissioning.

Recommissioning can stop an active decommission.

Once a broker is decommissioned, it cannot be recommissioned through this
command.

A recommission request is sent to every broker in the cluster, only
the cluster leader handles the request.

NOTE: This command was introduced in version v26.2.1.

== Usage

[,bash]
----
rpk cluster brokers recommission [BROKER ID] [flags]
----

== Global flags

[cols="1m,1a,2a"]
|===
|Value |Type |Description

|--config |string |Redpanda or `rpk` config file; default search paths are `~/.config/rpk/rpk.yaml`, `$PWD/redpanda.yaml`, and `/etc/redpanda/redpanda.yaml`.
|-X, --config-opt |stringArray |Override `rpk` configuration settings; `-X help` for detail or `-X list` for terser detail.
|--ignore-profile |bool |Ignore `rpk.yaml` and `redpanda.yaml`; use default settings.
|--profile |string |`rpk` profile to use.
|-v, --verbose |bool |Enable verbose logging.
|===
